format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-confirm id="c" question="Удалить файл «Отчёт.pdf»?" confirm-id="f-17" accept-text="Удалить" status="danger"></sf-confirm>

probes.title: The safe answer holds the focus; Shift+Tab reaches the accepting one; Enter confirms: sf-confirm-answer {id, accepted: true} once; the question is pending and the focus is on its status line
probes.covers: keyboard.host Tab reach, Enter select, events.answer, accessibility.name question, settings.status danger

steps.check: document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#c button[data-action="decline"]') && document.querySelector('#c section').getAttribute('role') === 'group' && document.querySelector('#c section').getAttribute('aria-labelledby') === document.querySelector('#c .sf-confirm__question').id && document.querySelector('#c button[data-action="accept"]').classList.contains('sf-button--danger')

probes.title: Escape inside the open question declines; a page that cancels the answer keeps the question open and the safe (declining) answer takes the focus back (decision C25)
a page button data-sf-action="d.confirm" confirms the question without words; the host's outcome leaves only «Готово»
probes.covers: actions.confirm (§8 one page trigger, §19.4), accessibility.name runtime.question-label

probes.title: answer {accepted} answers applied while open and refused closed once settled; an unknown answer is refused unknown

open() puts the question with the focus on the declining answer; a dangerous question fills its accepting answer and leaves the declining one quiet, a plain one keeps two outlined answers (decision C25)

steps.check: document.querySelector('#c').state === 'open' && document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#c button[data-action="decline"]') && document.querySelector('#c button[data-action="accept"]').closest('sf-button').getAttribute('appearance') === 'default' && document.querySelector('#c button[data-action="decline"]').closest('sf-button').getAttribute('appearance') === 'ghost' && document.querySelector('#d button[data-action="decline"]').closest('sf-button').getAttribute('appearance') === 'outline'
